title: Insertion & Deletion
definition: Adding to the end (`push`/`pop`) is O(1). Inserting or deleting in the middle (`splice`) is O(N) due to the need to shift elements to maintain contiguous memory blocks.
simpleExplanation: Adding a book to the right end of a shelf is easy. Squeezing a book into the middle requires pushing all the other books to the right to make room.

answers.question: **Basic:** Write a function to implement the core logic of Array Insertion.
**Intermediate 1:** Optimize Array Insertion to handle edge cases like empty arrays or negative numbers.
**Intermediate 2:** Solve a standard interview variation of Array Insertion (e.g. LeetCode Medium).
**Advanced:** Scale Array Insertion for massive datasets or implement it recursively.
**Expert/FAANG:** Solve Array Insertion in O(1) space or O(N) time when constraints are extremely tight.
